jobs.prompt:
Goal g-33a7a4ae, D-fix batch 27d (logging-only visibility round). Edit ONLY tools/api-adapters.mjs. This is a money-sensitive file (paid API lanes, spend caps, provider keys), so an Opus review follows. Visibility only: do NOT change control flow, return values, fallbacks, throws, exports, HTTP requests, response parsing, quota classification, spend/ledger behavior, or tests. No refactors or reformatting.

Audit: docs/state/silent-failures.md. These line numbers are CURRENT on origin/swarm/train8 (e18fcfb, 1.167.31). Locate each catch by the quoted code; bind the error exactly as described. Keep the same error handling and thrown AdapterError after the change.

Per-catch specification (file order):

1. line 465: in the `if (!response.ok)` path, `try { ... while (prefix.length < 4096) { const { done, value } = await reader.read(); ... } } catch { /* Preserve the HTTP status even when its error body is unreadable. */ }`. LOG-ALWAYS with fixed safe detail: bind error and `console.error('[tools/api-adapters.mjs] provider error body unreadable:', error?.code ?? error?.name ?? 'failed');`. Never log the body, prefix, headers, request URL, key, or error.message. The existing HTTP status, retry-after parsing and quotaExhausted classification must stay exactly as they are; prefix remains whatever bytes were read.

2. line 466: `finally { await reader.cancel().catch(() => {}); reader.releaseLock(); }` in the same error path. LEAVE (cleanup).

3. line 481: `finally { await reader.cancel().catch(() => {}); reader.releaseLock(); }` after the successful response body read. LEAVE (cleanup).

4. line 776: `for (const text of result.texts) { try { const parsed = JSON.parse(text); ... candidates.push(...) } catch { /* an invalid candidate is simply not a candidate */ } }` in best-of-N. LEAVE (an invalid candidate is filtered; the next line fails when none are valid).

Do not touch any other catch. Forbidden shortcuts: `catch (e) { e; }`, `.catch((_e) => ...)` with no real log, `void error`, unused binding.

After editing: run `node --import ./tests/_isolate-config.mjs --test tests/adapters.test.mjs tests/api-workers.test.mjs tests/best-of-adapter.test.mjs tests/openrouter.test.mjs tests/paid-lane-pause.test.mjs tests/multi-edit.test.mjs`. If a test fails because it asserts empty stderr on the newly logged error-body path, STOP and return blocked with the test name; do not edit a test. Final summary: one line per numbered catch saying changed (with the exact log text) or LEFT, plus the test result.
jobs.ignoreTestsReason: Logging-only error-path visibility; focused adapter tests are in context and run by the worker and integrate; the full suite runs in CI.
